caption:
Stop stuffing pillow covers with the wrong size insert.

Pillow covers are usually cut to a specific size, but the insert stuffed inside them often isn't a real match. When the insert runs smaller or flatter than the cover, the corners cave in and the whole pillow looks deflated no matter how nice the fabric is.

The Utopia Bedding 18x18 Pillow Inserts are cut to that exact 18 by 18 size, so they line up with a standard cover instead of leaving gaps. Over two hundred thousand people have rated them 4.6 stars.

The corners fill out edge to edge instead of caving in, and it runs about sixteen dollars.
